name: smoke-inverter
description: Harness acceptance test: a minimum-size CMOS inverter (nfet_03v3/pfet_03v3) in three static states. Not a PHY sub-block.
claim: None -- harness self-verification, not a spec claim. Proves the PVT plumbing (parameter substitution, .lib corner sections, .temp) actually takes effect, so later records against ratified spec lines (spec/usb2-device-phy.md) can be trusted.

voh_ratio.description: gate=0 output must sit near VDD at every corner

vol_ratio.description: gate=VDD output must sit near GND at every corner

vm.description: self-biased switching threshold; the spread floor proves the MOS .lib sections and .temp change the NMOS/PMOS strength ratio between corners

isup_ua.description: total supply current stays sane (sub-threshold leakage floor to a generous ceiling) at every corner
